title: Waystones issue #1202: Crash with FTB XMod Compat [Solution: Update FTB XMod Compat]
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by lerai77]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Describe the Issue

I usually play modpacks that allow for file editing; I'm currently playing AllTheMons. I updated Waystones to the latest version (1.21.1.36) and it crashed, so I had to revert to a previous version (1.21.1.35)—where the scroll button doesn't work.

### Logs

[crash-2026-07-11_09.57.07-server.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29927302/crash-2026-07-11_09.57.07-server.txt)

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
This is originating from FTB XMod Compat and is already being fixed (https://github.com/FTBTeam/FTB-XMod-Compat/commit/d7dd7a026bd016adcd34a7f1137f4f9d07fc9452).

As a workaround, disabling the `ONLY_SHOW_KNOWN_WAYSTONES` in FTB XMod Compat should prevent the crash until an update is released.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Should be fixed in FTB XMod Compat 21.1.9+
